name: Hormel Flagship Austin Plant - Austin MN

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (43.68237,-92.968394) pointed at Hormel World HQ / R&D campus, not the production plant. The flagship 1.3M sq ft processing plant is ~1.1 km south, centered ~43.6765,-92.9665, bounded by the Cedar River on the west and 14th Ave NE / residential streets on the east.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire property is fenced with chain-link plus privacy slats (confirmed in multiple Street Views). A guard-booth checkpoint with an apparent barrier arm straddles the internal truck road at ~43.6740,-92.9665 (z20 satellite). Web research confirms a 'guarded gate for security clearance' (CMac listing for Hormel Austin Plant main gate on 14th Ave, 507-437-5293).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small (~1-vehicle footprint) structure straddling the truck lane at the internal checkpoint, visible at z20.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scale likely present for a hog-receiving plant of this size but not positively isolated in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces (SW dock apron with trailers backed in; central-south building face) consistent with separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus of 10+ connected and standalone industrial buildings on one fenced property.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur runs along the east edge of the property into the plant area.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band; large multi-building food plant with extensive dock activity, trailers backed in on the SW face. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer-parking rows on the SW (50+ stalls of parked trailers without tractors).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons at the plant frontage and ample yard width provide room for a bypass/express lane.

citations.claim: Hormel's own locations page lists the Flagship Austin Plant: 1,900 team members, 1.3M sq ft, SPAM/ham/bacon/dry sausage.
FY2025 SEC filing; Austin MN is Hormel HQ and flagship plant, ongoing operations.

verification.rationale: Flagship HQ plant on Hormel's own locator with 1,900 workers; not on any T&M closure list; no negative found.
